bagPolicy.summary: All guests at the Bellco Theatre are subject to a search, including metal detection and bag inspection. Prohibited items include outside food and beverages, weapons, and recording devices.
prohibited: All outside food or beverages including alcoholic beverages
Weapons or any items construed as weapons
Air horns, bullhorns or other distracting noisemakers
Personal property that is potentially hazardous
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at the Bellco Theatre fills up quickly, and alternative parking options are available around the Convention Center. Parking rates are $13 for up to 8 hours, $16 for up to 12 hours, and $18 for up to 18 hours. SpotHero can be used to reserve parking in advance.

rideshare.note: The drop off/pick up area is recommended for guests who may not be able to walk far.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Bellco Theatre varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: For those guests with mobility restrictions, a passenger drop-off area is located just off Stout Street near the intersection of Speer Boulevard.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Bellco Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Bellco Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Bellco Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
